text_block_list.text: I saw Winning Ticket running over from the other side, bawling her eyes out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I did... I did such a terrible thing to Mr. Chalk... Waaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*... I got called on in class and had to go
up to the blackboard to write the answer, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was so pumped, thinking "All right, I'm gonna get every question right!",
and when I grabbed Mr. Chalk...
that's when...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Chalk went 'SNAP'!!
And broke into twooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's my fault... It's all my fault!
Mr. Chalk had so much more left to write...!!
It seems Winning Ticket needs to learn how to relax a little...
